description: P14: the spec section 16 stress route - 12 combatants that respawn, 20 breakables in clusters on an 8-stop route, at most 40 debris - on a walled 160 x 160 m floor. Run it with --level=res://scenes/test/stress_arena.tscn --scenario=stress --autoplay=300 --graphics=low (docs/PERFORMANCE.md). It has no encounters (StressScenario spawns the combatants); its render presets match the Valley's, so the graphics preset measured here is the one the Valley runs.
